about.title: About Kabuki Archive
about.p1: Kabuki Archive is a fan project that gathers Honkai: Star Rail data in one place.
about.p2: We only publish content after the official announcement. Pages from recent patches show a spoiler warning, removed automatically 2 weeks after the patch release.
about.p3: The code is open source (MIT license). Game data, images and text belong to HoYoverse.
